text.p: Hibernia Corp. said Wednesday it agreed to buy privately held Unicorp Bancshares-Texas Inc. for about $28 million in stock.
Hibernia will also assume Unicorp's outstanding debt.

A Hibernia spokesman said the company will offer 1.6 Hibernia shares for each Unicorp share in a tax-free pooling of interests. The exact exchange ratio will be determined by the price of Hibernia stock at the close of the deal.
Hibernia rose 12.5 cents to $13.125 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
Hibernia, based in New Orleans, said the merger is expected to close during the fourth quarter, subject to approvals by regulators and Unicorp shareholders.
Unicorp, based in Orange, La., operates OrangeBank, which has an 18 percent deposit market share in Orange County.

Following completion of this and another pending merger with Executive Bancshares, Inc., a two-bank holding company based in Paris in northeast Texas, Hibernia will have $9.6 billion in assets and 205 branches in Louisiana and Texas.
